nodes.label: GraphStore Protocol (DESIGN.md)
nodes.rationale: Python Protocol defining upsert_vertices, upsert_edges, neighbors, traverse, find, shortest_path, and health so application layers never bind to vendor query drivers.

nodes.label: Iceberg + PuppyGraph Zero-ETL Adapter
nodes.rationale: Dual-mode zero-ETL execution writing domain/bucket_16 Parquet/Iceberg tables and puppygraph_schema.json, supporting remote PuppyGraph Cypher/Gremlin or local partition-pruned PyArrow scans (>=50% I/O reduction).

nodes.label: Apache HugeGraph (Primary)
nodes.rationale: Selected as primary 1B-10B+ candidate due to built-in Placement Driver (PD) and Raft-replicated distributed HStore.

nodes.label: Pluggable GraphStore Interface
nodes.rationale: Abstracts physical graph engines behind a unified interface so backends can be swapped or benchmarked without changing agent or GraphRAG retrieval code.

nodes.label: Neo4j (Baseline)
nodes.rationale: Provides fast local development and small-to-medium single-cluster baseline.

nodes.label: Epic E2 (SEN-62): Pluggable GraphStore & Multi-Engine Adapters
nodes.norm_label: epic e2 (sen-62): pluggable graphstore & multi-engine adapters

nodes.label: Standalone Operation & Public Contract Rule
nodes.rationale: Preserve standalone operation, integrate through backward-compatible public contracts, and keep business logic independent from provider SDKs and storage implementation.

nodes.label: Epic E1 (SEN-61): Core Domain Model, Guardrails & Supernode Mitigation
nodes.norm_label: epic e1 (sen-61): core domain model, guardrails & supernode mitigation

nodes.label: Derived Edge Query-Time Inference & Promotion
nodes.rationale: Rejects unmaterialized derived edges at write time and computes SIMILAR_TO/INDIRECTLY_USES on-the-fly in QueryCoordinator until query hit frequency promotes them to materialized_hot_path=True.

nodes.label: Uniform Supernode Bucketing & Registry
nodes.rationale: Uses intermediate bucket vertices (<hub_id>::bucket::0..15) across all engines with seeded hubs and auto-promotion; bucket hops do not count toward the 3-hop cap and are unwrapped before returning paths.

nodes.label: Engine Feasibility Validation (Oct 2026)
nodes.rationale: Corrected Infinigraph licensing assumptions (available in Neo4j Enterprise/AuraDB) and flagged HugeGraph HStore production maturity as unverified pending PoC gate.

nodes.rationale: Engine selection is decided at Gate 2 from measured PoC latency, ingestion throughput, HA recovery, and cost per billion edges rather than vendor claims.

nodes.label: ADR & Claim Discipline Rule
nodes.rationale: Document architectural exceptions as ADRs in docs/decisions/ and distinguish verified, implemented, experimental, and planned behavior in README.

nodes.label: Hybrid Vector + KG Seed-Then-Expand + RRF
nodes.rationale: Retrieves top-K vector seeds, runs guarded 1-3 hop expansion, fuses vector and graph proximity scores with Reciprocal Rank Fusion, and hydrates only final top-N payloads from LakehouseContentStore.

nodes.label: Partitioning & Locality Strategy
nodes.rationale: Uses domain and tenant partition hints (HugeGraph PD) to co-locate high-affinity subgraphs and deterministic global IDs for cross-domain edge portability.

nodes.label: Lean Semantic Graph Architecture
nodes.rationale: Stores only entity nodes, typed relationships, and traversal-relevant properties in the graph while linking full documents and embeddings in authoritative stores via reference URIs to scale from 100M to 10B+ edges.

nodes.label: Ghost/Proxy Nodes for Cross-Shard Federation
nodes.rationale: Storing proxy nodes (is_proxy=True, target_domain) inside owning shards lets local edge scans inform QueryCoordinator which remote shard owns the next hop without central directory lookups per edge.

nodes.label: Domain-Prefixed Global Entity ID Routing
nodes.rationale: Domain-prefixed canonical IDs (<domain>:<entity_type>:<slug>) enable O(1) zero-lookup Hop-0 routing, backed by EntityDirectory fallback for opaque/legacy IDs.

nodes.label: 24-Week Roadmap & Benchmark Decision Gate
nodes.rationale: Weighted Week-12 100M/1B decision gate: Performance 35%, Scalability & Resilience 25%, Cost/B Edges 15%, Operability 15%, GraphRAG Ecosystem Fit 10%.

nodes.label: Supernode-Safe Query Service
nodes.rationale: Enforces hop depth bounds (1-3 hops), per-hop fan-out caps, time-sliced edge bucketing, and query caching to prevent high-degree vertex latency spikes.

nodes.label: Supernode Handling Strategy
nodes.rationale: Guards high-degree vertices at ingestion and query time via degree detection, edge bucketing/time slicing, vertex-centric indexes, and Query Service depth/fan-out caps.

nodes.label: Graph Scaling Properties (4 Core Challenges)
nodes.rationale: Hash partitioning breaks traversal locality, traversal fans out exponentially, supernodes concentrate partition load, and derived edges multiply graph size by billions.
nodes.source_file: docs/proposal/Scaling the Semantic Knowledge Graph Project Proposal.md

nodes.label: Ordered 7-Lever Scaling Strategy
nodes.rationale: Applies edge reduction, depth caps, supernode fixes, indexes, and read replicas before semantic domain partitioning and federation because sharding multiplies the cost of a poorly modelled graph.
